description: Corporate Weather helps users understand visible workplace-weather signals across the DACH market. It turns public, evidence-style signals such as hiring activity, company communications, DACH business press indicators, and workplace review patterns into a calm, explainable report. The app does not predict layoffs and does not provide legal advice. It highlights visible risk signals, calm counter-signals, confidence, missing evidence, and what to watch next.

defaultPrompt: Show me the Corporate Weather radar for DACH companies
